title: ever OLIVIA|Long Sleeves Chiffon Empire Waist A-Line Maxi Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into timeless elegance with our Long Sleeves Chiffon Empire Waist A-Line Maxi Formal Evening Dress. Designed with a flattering empire waist and flowy A-line silhouette, this dress creates an effortlessly graceful look. The long chiffon sleeves add sophistication, making it perfect for formal events or evening occasions. The soft chiffon fabric ensures both style and comfort throughout the night.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
